title_en: Fall Semester 2026 Graduate Module-Specific "Master's/Doctoral Seminar" Courses: Audit (청강) Guidance (New Students / Integrated Programme Students Entering the Doctoral Stage)
summary: Students who must audit the module-specific Master's/Doctoral Seminar in Fall Semester 2026 must apply for the audit by emailing the teaching assistant of the relevant course by Wednesday, 12 August 2026. During the first semester of the seminar, students must not formally register for the course.
applies_to: As stated in the title: new graduate students and integrated Master's-Doctoral programme students entering the doctoral stage. The notice specifically states that new graduate students admitted for the second half (fall) of the 2026 academic year must check Attachment 1. Integrated programme students take the Master's Seminar audit in their 1st semester and the Doctoral Seminar audit in their 4th semester (based on entering the doctoral stage in the 4th semester). Students must audit a course offered by their own (advisor's) module, except that for the Master's Seminar in the 'Semiconductor' (반도체) and 'Computer' (컴퓨터) modules, students may audit the course matching their presentation topic.

dates.what: Deadline to apply for auditing the Master's/Doctoral Seminar
English Presentation Skills Seminar (planned online via Zoom; optional for auditing students; details to be announced later)

steps: New students admitted in Fall 2026: read Attachment 1 (Guidance on Auditing the Required Graduate Master's/Doctoral Seminar, for new students) attached to the original notice. Its content was not read for this translation.

Find the Master's/Doctoral Seminar course offered by your own (advisor's) module and its teaching assistant in Attachment 2 (list of the 16 module-specific seminar courses and teaching assistants). Its content was not read for this translation. Semiconductor and Computer module students taking the Master's Seminar may choose the course matching their presentation topic.
By Wednesday, 12 August 2026, send an email to the teaching assistant of the chosen course, stating your student ID number, name, academic advisor, email address and mobile phone number.
Do not formally register for the seminar course during the course registration period in your first (audit) semester.
Optionally, apply for the English Presentation Skills Seminar on 4 September 2026 if you wish to attend; application details will be announced in a later notice.
translation:
Fall Semester 2026 Graduate Module-Specific "Master's/Doctoral Seminar" (석박세미나) Courses: Audit (청강) Guidance (New Students / Integrated Programme Students Entering the Doctoral Stage)
Posted: 3 August 2026

We announce the application for auditing (청강) the graduate module-specific "Master's/Doctoral Seminar" courses for Fall Semester 2026.
New graduate students admitted for the fall (second half) of the 2026 academic year must check the contents of [Attachment 1] to ensure they apply for the audit correctly.

1. Overview of the Graduate Module-Specific "Master's/Doctoral Seminar"
- It is a required condition for completing the Master's and Doctoral programmes. Master's and Doctoral seminars are offered every semester by each module, and students must take the seminar of their own module before completion.
- It runs over two semesters. The first semester is conducted as an audit (청강) without course registration, and in the second semester students earn 3 credits through course registration and an English presentation.
- Integrated Master's-Doctoral programme students must complete both the Master's Seminar and the Doctoral Seminar (based on entering the doctoral stage in the 4th semester).
  · Master's Seminar: audit in the 1st semester → course registration and presentation in the 2nd semester (3 credits)
  · Doctoral Seminar: audit in the 4th semester → course registration and presentation in the 5th semester (3 credits)
  ※ In the first semester (1st or 4th semester), students do not formally register for the course; it is conducted only as an audit.

2. Audit Application
- Deadline: by Wednesday, 12 August 2026
- Method: apply by email to the teaching assistant of the desired course (see [Attachment 2])
- Information to submit: student ID number / name / academic advisor / email address / mobile phone number

3. English Presentation Skills Seminar (details will be announced later)
- Date, time and place: Friday, 4 September 2026, 2:00–3:00 p.m., planned to be held online (Zoom)
- Content: a lecture on English presentation skills
- Note: attendance is not required for auditing students; only those who wish to attend may apply (participation is recommended in the semester in which you register for the course).

4. Important Notes
A. Courses with the same name other than the 16 courses listed in [Attachment 2] are not the required Master's/Doctoral Seminar; they are recognised as general graduate courses (they have a different subtitle code/subtitle name (부제코드/부제명)).
B. Because the first semester of the module-specific Master's/Doctoral Seminar is conducted as an audit, take care not to formally register for the course during the course registration period.
C. You must apply to audit a course offered by the module to which you (your academic advisor) belong (see [Attachment 2]).
  ※ For the Master's Seminar of the 'Semiconductor' (반도체) and 'Computer' (컴퓨터) modules, you may apply to audit the course that matches your presentation topic.

5. Inquiries: the department office (학부사무실), Building 301, Room 319. The contact details are given in the original notice.

[Attachment 1] Guidance on Auditing the Required Graduate Master's/Doctoral Seminar, Fall Semester 2026 (New Students)
[Attachment 2] List of Module-Specific Master's/Doctoral Seminar Courses and Teaching Assistants, Fall Semester 2026

Attached files (2):
[붙임1] 2026학년도 2학기 대학원 필수 석박세미나 '청강' 안내(신입생).pdf (92 KB)
[붙임2] 2026학년도 2학기 모듈별 석박세미나 수업조교 명단_홈페이지 공지용.pdf (54 KB)
